title: AIVV Calibration Record
description: Machine-parseable envelope for a single calibration record. As of per-invocation sharding contract () a lens's records are sharded one JSONL file per invocation at `.aivv/calibration/<lens>/<invocation-id>.jsonl`; the legacy shared `.aivv/calibration/<lens>.jsonl` remains readable and readers union both. This schema validates ONE record (one JSONL line); a shard file is a sequence of such lines validated line-by-line, NOT a single JSON document (a bare `ajv validate` against a whole shard file will not work — validate each line). Append-only JSON Lines — one record per line. The prose-source-of-truth for human readers is `.aivv/calibration/README.md`; this JSON Schema is the machine-readable contract emitted by `/aivv` Step 7 and `/aivv-fix` Step 7 and consumed by `/aivv-calibrate` (dev.31+). Schema graduation: dev.32 (trigger: `/aivv-calibrate` shipped in dev.31, satisfying the README's prior 'deferred to v0.2 when read-side analytics ship' precondition). Universally-required base fields: `lens`, `kind`, `ts`. Kind-specific required fields are enforced via the `oneOf` discriminator. Convergence-kind suffix tolerance per dev.31 policy: kinds prefixed `dual_<true|false>_positive` or `n_way_<true|false>_positive(_agreement)` admit an optional trailing `_<context>` suffix opaque to the schema. Citation evidence per dev.18 reviewer-grounding methodology may be carried in two forms: the typed `grounded_by` array (preferred, dev.31+) or as legacy free-form `grounded_by:{<source_type>:<source_ref>}` substrings inside any string field (accepted during the migration window). Severity values are case-insensitive — both UPPER (`CRITICAL`) and lower (`critical`) appear in extant corpora; both are accepted without normalization.

lens.description: Review lens. Shipped: general (broad goal-fit, evidence, design, and risk review), code (legacy finding default, dev.1+), sec + visual (dev.22+), ux + polish (dev.43+), compliance (WCAG AAA + ARIA APG full + legal-risk; dev.105), i18n (translation discipline + CLDR + Intl.* + RTL; dev.105), user-journey (user-journey lens; dev.121). Forward-look planned: perf, a11y (Tier 2/3+). Enum mirrors finding.json envelope's lens enum; calibration corpora group by lens directory (e.g., .aivv/calibration/general/<invocation-id>.jsonl shards, plus any legacy .aivv/calibration/general.jsonl).

kind.description: Calibration category. Bare canonical forms: false_positive, dual_false_positive, n_way_false_positive, true_positive, dual_true_positive, n_way_true_positive_agreement, false_negative, bad_fix, auto_deferred_at_cap, review_meta, fix_introduced_bug, challenger_caught_issue, challenger_false_positive, recurring_class_missed, challenge_budget_exhausted, pre_write_validator_caught, pre_write_validator_false_positive, manual_bypass_approved, pre_write_unsupported_shape. Convergence kinds may carry an operator-extended `_<context>` suffix (e.g., `dual_true_positive_on_orchestrator_defaults`) — readers MUST treat any kind whose prefix matches a canonical convergence form as the canonical kind. HISTORICAL: `auto_deferred_at_cap` is no longer emitted — its producer (the `/aivv-fix` Step 4 cap-disposition rule, dev.110) was removed at dev.157 when the narrative-drift surfacers it keyed on (`validate.sh` Stages 15/17/18/19/20) were deleted at dev.155; the kind + its `oneOf` branch are retained for read-compat of existing calibration records.

ts.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with `Z` suffix. When the record was written. Pattern matches `2026-04-22T08:07:11.147952Z` and `2026-04-22T08:07:11Z`.

finding.description: One-line summary. Present on FP-family and TP-family kinds.

severity.description: Severity as flagged by the reviewer. Case-insensitive accepted (extant corpora carry both UPPER and lower forms). POLISH (dev.41+) is an orthogonal value-add tier — not on the defect axis CRITICAL/MAJOR/MINOR; see .aivv/methodology.md Severity model. Present on FP-family and TP-family kinds.

impact_tier.description: Optional legacy-schema compatibility rules DEFECT-track impact tier captured when calibrating a finding emitted under `severity_model: impact_likelihood`. Mirrors finding.json and is stored alongside `likelihood` so reviewers can later audit whether the severity cell-map was applied correctly.

likelihood.description: Optional legacy-schema compatibility rules DEFECT-track likelihood captured when calibrating a finding emitted under `severity_model: impact_likelihood`. Mirrors finding.json and is stored alongside `impact_tier` so calibration can distinguish high-impact rare defects from high-impact common defects.

manifestation.description: Optional impact-likelihood outcome evidence. `observed` means the defect or harm mode manifested in runtime, tests, user report, incident evidence, or a reproduced failure. `not_observed` means the finding was confirmed real but no manifestation was observed in the available evidence window. `unknown` preserves that no manifestation evidence is available and is excluded from likelihood-calibration percentages. FP/TP adjudication is reviewer-correctness evidence, not a substitute for this field.

value.description: Optional legacy-schema compatibility rules IMPROVEMENT-track value rating for POLISH findings. Mirrors finding.json and supports Quick-Win calibration without promoting behavior-preserving improvements to defect tiers.

effort.description: Optional legacy-schema compatibility rules IMPROVEMENT-track effort rating for POLISH findings. Mirrors finding.json and pairs with `value`; `value: high` plus `effort: trivial` is the Quick-Win shape.

reason.description: Free-form explanation. Common on FP records (why dismissed) and on convergence records (signal interpretation). Either `reason` or `evidence` (or both) typically present on FP/TP records.

evidence.description: Free-form supporting detail. Common on TP records (why a real defect) and on FP records (verification context). Either `reason` or `evidence` (or both) typically present on FP/TP records.

fix_regression.description: What broke after the fix was applied. Required on `bad_fix` records.

root_cause_of_bad_fix.description: Why the fix went wrong. Free-form (per dev.29 calibration README guidance). Example values observed so far: `prerequisite-not-met`, `other`. Required on `bad_fix` records. Promotion to formal enum gated on N≥3 distinct empirical values per Operating Principle 1.

findings_produced.description: `findings_produced` is integer >=0; count of the in-memory canonical findings array Step 7.5 will write to the review log. For `cold_multi_review` and `cold_multi_model`, use the post-dedup synthesized finding count from Step 6, not the sum of per-reviewer or per-provider raw findings; for `cold_single_review` and `same_agent_review`, use parsed JSONL sidecar count. Zero-finding clean reviews emit 0.

reviewers.description: Number of reviewers in the session. Mirrors `review_log.reviewers`. Required on `review_meta` records.

review_id.description: Invocation ID linking the record back to `<target>/.aivv/state/review-<id>.json` (or `fix-<id>.json` when `/aivv-fix` writes the record per the de-dup contract). Unique key for the `review_meta` corpus. Required on `review_meta` records.

excerpt.description: Optional short excerpt or quote supporting the record. Free-form.

original_fix_finding_id.description: Finding ID from the prior /aivv-fix session whose fix introduced the regression. Required on `fix_introduced_bug` records.

regression_summary.description: One-line description of the regression introduced by the prior fix. Required on `fix_introduced_bug` records.

caught_by_round.description: Cycle number (cycle_count) at which the regression was caught by the verifier. Required on `fix_introduced_bug` records.

predecessor_review_id.description: ID of the predecessor review session that introduced the regression. Format matches the review-log `id` field pattern. Required on `fix_introduced_bug` records (non-null); null on records emitted from within-invocation Case A regressions when no prior /aivv review preceded the fix-cycle.

fix_confidence_at_plan.description: Optional on per-fix-finding kinds (fix_introduced_bug, challenger_caught_issue, challenger_false_positive); carries the fix_confidence value computed at Step 4 PLAN (Change 2). NOT in required[] — added when emitting the per-fix record.

fix_outcome.description: Optional on per-fix-finding kinds; carries the Step 6 verifier outcome. NOT in required[] — added when emitting the per-fix record.

finding_id.description: The finding ID this calibration record refers to. Required on `challenger_caught_issue`, `challenger_false_positive`, and `recurring_class_missed` records.

challenger_verdict.description: The verdict returned by the Step 4.5 challenger (REVISE or REJECT). Required on `challenger_caught_issue` records.

concern_kind.description: The concern kind from the challenger (e.g., regression-risk, unverified-execution-claim). Required on `challenger_caught_issue` and `challenger_false_positive` records.

fix_revised.description: Whether the fix was revised after the challenger's REVISE/REJECT verdict. Required on `challenger_caught_issue` records.

user_override_reason.description: Explanation of why the user overrode the challenger's concern. Required on `challenger_false_positive` records.

class_signature.description: Grep-pattern (≤120 chars) describing the generalizable class this finding belongs to. Required on `recurring_class_missed` records.

sibling_locations.description: File:line locations matching the class_signature that were NOT in the original fix scope. Required on `recurring_class_missed` records.

invocation_id.description: The /aivv-fix invocation ID where the challenge budget was exhausted. Required on `challenge_budget_exhausted` records.

max_challenges.description: The max_challenges_per_invocation value that was hit. Required on `challenge_budget_exhausted` records.

batches_skipped.description: Number of batches that did not receive a challenger due to budget exhaustion. Required on `challenge_budget_exhausted` records.

context.description: Optional structured context for calibration records. For B4 challenge_budget_exhausted records this may include write_intent_risk, detector_verdicts, batches_skipped_safe, and batches_halted_risky.

validator_check.description: Which Step 5.4 sub-check caught the defect. Required on `pre_write_validator_caught` records. (The proposed 4th kind `count-matches-enumeration` was dropped per 2026-05-22 user gate — count-vs-enumeration drift is addressed by eliminating bare-count-in-prose at authoring time per maintainer guidance dev.119+, not by deterministic validation.)

would_have_been_n_class.description: One-line description of the defect class that would have shipped if Step 5.4 hadn't caught it (e.g., 'dotted-string property key', 'L<N> drift'). Required on `pre_write_validator_caught` records.

grounded_by.description: Optional structured citation evidence. Same shape as `finding.json#/properties/grounded_by`. The legacy `grounded_by:{<source_type>:<source_ref>}` substring form inside any string field remains accepted during the migration window — readers MUST handle both forms. Absence is valid: not every record rests on a groundable claim.

write_intent_id.description: B4 write intent ID associated with bypass or unsupported-shape calibration records.

shape.description: Detected B4 content shape, e.g. unsupported-risky-shape.

approval_event_id.description: Host user input event ID for a manual bypass approval.

content_sha.description: Approved write-intent content hash for B4 bypass calibration records.

false_positive_reason.description: Why a pre-write validator halt was later determined harmless.

oneOf.title: FP family (false_positive + dual/n_way convergence + suffix-extended forms)
oneOf.description: False-positive records — the reviewer flagged a finding that turned out not to be a real defect. Convergence forms (`dual_false_positive`, `n_way_false_positive`) plus operator-extended suffixed forms.

oneOf.title: TP family (true_positive + dual/n_way convergence + suffix-extended forms)
oneOf.description: True-positive records — the reviewer flagged a finding that was confirmed as a real defect. Convergence forms (`dual_true_positive`, `n_way_true_positive_agreement`) plus operator-extended suffixed forms.

oneOf.title: false_negative — missed bug recorded post-ship
oneOf.description: A real defect that the reviewer(s) failed to catch. Recorded after the fact (post-ship empirical evidence).

oneOf.title: bad_fix — regression introduced by /aivv-fix (dev.29+)
oneOf.description: A fix proposed and executed by `/aivv-fix` later found to have introduced a regression. Distinct from FP (fix wasn't needed) and FN (fix didn't catch a real bug).

oneOf.title: auto_deferred_at_cap — Phase 1 cap-residual auto-disposition (dev.110+, AIVV-self only)
oneOf.description: Records a cycle-3 cap-residual finding auto-classified by the /aivv-fix Step 4 three-gate auto-disposition rule: severity ∈ {MINOR, POLISH}, grounded_by exclusively cites validate.sh Stage 15-19, target-project marker-file check returns AIVV-self. Per-cycle ephemeral — does NOT populate wont-fix-registry; the same finding may re-surface and be auto-deferred again.

oneOf.title: review_meta — per-review-session metadata (dev.31+)
oneOf.description: One record per `/aivv` invocation regardless of finding count. Provides the `findings_produced` denominator for the 'findings per review' trend. Excluded from FP/TP-rate denominators.

fix_confidence_distribution.description: Optional. Distribution of fix_confidence scores across all findings in the session. Populated by /aivv-fix Step 7 when fix_confidence was computed for at least one finding.

thoroughness.description: Optional. The resolved thoroughness dial tier for this review session. Enforced enum (the branch lives inside the kind-discriminated oneOf).

oneOf.title: fix_introduced_bug — regression introduced by a prior /aivv-fix cycle
oneOf.description: Auto-emitted by Step 6 when a regression finding's file matches a files_modified entry from the prior round's session_changes. Captures fix-quality post-mortems without manual annotation.

oneOf.title: challenger_caught_issue — Step 4.5 REVISE/REJECT led to a corrected fix
oneOf.description: Auto-emitted by Step 7 when the fix-challenger returned REVISE/REJECT, a revised fix was applied, and Step 6 verifier confirmed the revised fix resolved the finding.

oneOf.title: challenger_false_positive — challenger concern overridden by user; original fix correct
oneOf.description: Auto-emitted by Step 7 when the challenger raised a concern that the user explicitly overrode AND Step 6 verifier confirmed the original fix was correct.

oneOf.title: recurring_class_missed — a finding's class_signature matched a regression's location
oneOf.description: Auto-emitted by Step 6 when a regression finding's location matches a prior finding's class_signature pattern.

oneOf.title: challenge_budget_exhausted — token-budget circuit-breaker fired in Step 4.5
oneOf.description: Informational. Emitted by Step 4.5 when max_challenges_per_invocation is reached; remaining batches skip the challenger.

oneOf.title: pre_write_validator_caught — Step 5.4 PRE-WRITE-VALIDATE deterministically caught a defect (dev.124+)
pre_write_validator_false_positive — B4 pre-write halt later determined harmless
manual_bypass_approved — host user approved a per-intent unsupported-risky-shape bypass
pre_write_unsupported_shape — unsupported risky shape halted without bypass
